cohort: 1,771,700 singleton births from 885,850 women in the Swedish Medical Birth Registry between 1982 and 2012
finding: Previous cesarean delivery is associated with an increased risk of stillbirth in subsequent pregnancies, particularly for pre-labor CD.
mod_finding: While a previous CD was associated with increased odds of stillbirth, VBAC itself was not associated with increased odds of intrapartum stillbirth compared to repeat CD.
